title: Transitivity in Inhomogeneous Random Tournaments
summary: Paired-comparison data are naturally represented by tournaments, where transitivity corresponds to the existence of a global ranking consistent with all pairwise outcomes. Accordingly, the classical Kendall-Smith coefficient of consistency measures deviations from transitivity in a tournament by counting the number of circular triads (directed $3$-cycles). In this paper, we characterize the fluctuations of the number of circular triads in inhomogeneous random tournaments and develop an inferential framework for the consistency coefficient.
